nodes.label: Alpha Blending Compositing
nodes.rationale: Composites RGBA/LA/P transparency over solid white canvas to prevent black or magenta halo borders that destroy 3D silhouette reconstruction.

nodes.label: Aspect-Ratio Preserving Resize and Canvas Padding
nodes.norm_label: aspect-ratio preserving resize and canvas padding
nodes.rationale: Calculates uniform scale factor and centers sketch on padded canvas with cv2.INTER_AREA to avoid pixel-skipping on thin lines, geometric distortion, and camera clipping during 3D novel view synthesis.

nodes.label: Edge-Preserving Bilateral Noise Reduction
nodes.rationale: Applies cv2.bilateralFilter to smooth paper grain and background sensor noise while preserving sharp contours and delicate pencil lines.

nodes.label: Conservative CLAHE Contrast Enhancement
nodes.rationale: Converts RGB to CIELAB and applies CLAHE adaptively to the Lightness (L) channel to enhance faint pencil strokes without color shifts or overexposure.

nodes.label: Polarity Normalization
nodes.rationale: Detects chalkboard or dark canvas inputs and automatically inverts white-on-black strokes to dark-on-white.

nodes.label: Conservative Thresholding Strategy
nodes.rationale: Binarization is disabled by default because it destroys anti-aliasing and stroke pressure variations relied upon by diffusion priors for depth estimation.
